points.description: States that a class can have an unlimited (any number of / many) constructors (e.g., via overloading with different parameters).
points.partial_credit: Award 2-3 marks if the student says 'more than one' or 'multiple' without saying there is no limit, or mentions overloading but gives no number.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying any number, unlimited, or many constructors can be made, in any wording. Part marks for vague answers like 'more than one' or 'several' that don't say there's no limit. No marks for a specific fixed number (e.g., one or two) or an unrelated answer.
